question: Who founded the company that makes the Zed phone?

paragraphs.title: Zed phone
paragraphs.paragraph_text: The Zed phone is made by Nova Corp.

paragraphs.title: Nova Corp
paragraphs.paragraph_text: Nova Corp was founded by Maria Lopez in 2001.

paragraphs.title: Old Corp
paragraphs.paragraph_text: Old Corp was founded by John Smith.
